lines.en: label christmastwo18:
I can’t just stay up here.
But I can’t just get up either.
Especially not with the weight of years worth of lost time and thousands if not millions of self-inflicted misdirections pressing down upon me.
Niki isn’t the only person who wants to see me right now. That much is an indisputable fact.
But-
Right now-
She is the one I want to see.
Maybe it means something, maybe it doesn’t.
I’m in no condition to explain it- and I likely won’t be for quite some time.
But I can’t keep her waiting when she’s already waited this long.
: I’m on my way.
scene black
The walk downstairs is a painful one, and not just because my legs haven’t yet recovered from being tethered to what felt like another dimension.
It’s painful because even if everything goes perfectly once I make it outside of the hotel, the second I head back in, it will be reduced to fragments once again.
Past or no past, things are different now.
Remembering one thing does not change that.
In fact, up until a few minutes ago, I was under the impression that remembering anything at all could kill me.
But I feel more alive right now than I have in a long time.
I just don’t know if that’s good or not.
My phone goes off again...probably because Niki is tired of waiting and-
Oh.
Apparently it’s something else.
: Hey. It’s Maya. Where are you?
Thankfully, this seemingly endless loop of stairs gives me enough time to respond without a fiery pink haired girl clapping back at me for not paying enough attention to her.
: I didn’t realize you had my number.
: I’ve had it this whole time. I just didn’t want you bothering me more than you already do.
: Fair enough. But why do you want to know where I am?
: Because I want to see you.
: Can you come up to the roof? I’ll be there shortly. I just have to do something else first.
Did Maya just...actually say she wants to see me?
There’s way too much happening all of a sudden. So much that I’m starting to question exactly how much of tonight has even been real.
: Didn't you say the roof was closed earlier?
: It was.
: I guess someone must have unlocked it. I don't know. Are you coming or not?
: Sure. But I also have to do something else first.
: That’s fine. See you there.
My phone goes back into my pocket.
My legs go back to work.
$ mayanumber = True
scene nikilove1
I find Niki and-
: I love you, okay?!
And that happens.
: I know that Noriko gave you all of my letters and I want you to know that-
: Niki-
: Shut the fuck up and let me finish!
: I know that you probably think I’m insane for waiting for you for so long and, you know what?! Maybe I am!
: But I never stopped thinking about you! Even when I dedicated my entire fucking life to making it so you could never run away from me ever again!
: I wanted to follow you everywhere! And since I couldn’t do it in person, I did it through the radio! TV! Billboards! Everything!
: I wanted to be there every second of your miserable fucking life because I can’t stand the thought of mine without you!
scene nikilove2
: Look at me! I’m screaming my fucking lungs out on Christmas in some random ass hotel where I could get caught at any second! And I don’t care!
: I don’t care if anyone sees this and posts it on the fucking Internet or tries to blackmail me or anything! I literally don’t care!
: I feel like that’s something you’ll wind up regretting once you’ve actually thought about it rationally.
: You’re not fucking getting it. I can’t think about anything rationally anymore.
: You ripped my heart and my mind to shreds and becoming...this? This is just the glue I used to put it all back together.
: It doesn’t look the same. It doesn’t feel the same. Literally nothing about it is the same and it’s because I know now that I can never be me without you.
scene nikilove3
: Come home.
: Come be with me.
: Come stay in fancy hotels and eat junk food and watch Gunfighter Z until we pass out.
: It’ll be exactly the same as it used to be, just...not in my parents’ house. Which I think is a pretty sweet improvement since all they ever did was get in the way anyway.
: Niki-
: I love you. More than you can ever fucking imagine. I love you so much.
: I know you do.
: I finally remembered something a few minutes ago when I was reading your letters.
scene nikilove4
: What? Really? What was it?
: Just a random night.
: We were in your room on Christmas watching that same anime you just mentioned.
: Your parents were having a party downstairs and-
: That was the first night we kissed.
: What?
: Yeah. You teased me about blushing and I got really embarrassed and spent the rest of the night trying to prove that I didn’t think of you that way.
: I failed miserably.
: Yeah...it sounds like it.
scene nikilove5
: So that’s what you remembered before anything else, huh?
: I always figured that since we didn’t really get together until way later that...you had kind of just...forgotten about it.
: Well, you did forget about it. But I’m talking about, like...before you...
: God, we’re so fucking old now.
scene black
Niki shows no sign of stopping anytime soon and moves closer to me.

I haven’t been able to really get any words in, but I figure that might be for the best since anything I could possibly say right now would just crush her feelings as if they were an insect underfoot.
I don’t want to do that to her.
Especially not when the vast majority of insects die in less than a year to begin with.
I’ll let this one live for now.
It interests me.
scene nikilove6
: So, uhh...are you going to keep those letters? Because, if I remember correctly, I might have said a lot of really mean stuff in some of them and I’d prefer you didn’t see any of it.
: You say a lot of really mean stuff in person, too. I doubt it would affect me all that much.
: Well it clearly affects you in some way, seeing as they helped chip away at that amnesia of yours.
: It’s a little upsetting that the memory didn’t last long enough for me to see that kiss.
: What kind of weirdo wants to watch his younger self kiss a little girl?
: I just meant that it might be a nice thing to remember. I didn’t mean it in a weird way.
scene nikilove7
: You know we can always just make more memories, right?
: As great as the old ones are, you can rely on me to fill in the gaps and tell you about all of the important stuff.
: I’ll say it again. Be with me. For real this time.
: We’re not awkward teenagers anymore. We can do it right this time.
: What happened to not wanting a relationship?
: What happened is I stopped lying to myself.
: Noriko helped push me in the right direction as well which, honestly, I was not expecting at all.
: I really thought she was going to go all-in on winning you over in my place.
: And, all things considered, I’m glad she didn’t because I would have broken her fucking neck.
: Aren’t idols...not allowed to date, though?
scene nikilove8
: Nope. So either I can be an extremely rare exception to that rule or...I can just graduate.
: You’re going back to school?
: What? No. It’s like the idol version of retiring.
: You love your career, though. Why would you give that up?
: Obviously because there’s something else I love more.
: Niki, you-
scene nikilove9
: The way I look at it is this...
: I became an idol to make you jealous and regretful and, instead, wound up winning over nearly everyone except you.
: You don’t give two shits about how famous I am. So even if I like it, the plan kind of failed.
: I don’t have to rely on the media to reach you anymore. I can fit your address and contact information in the palm of my hand.
scene nikilove10
: So...if you’ll have me again...I’ll give all of that up.
: I have plenty of money. And my contract with the agency says that I’ll still make royalties even if I’m fired or decide to quit.
: Let’s start over.
: We were meant for each other. I know it.
: Don’t you want that again?
: Don’t you think that the key to not feeling so empty all the time is to stick with someone who knows what’s missing?
: What if I don’t, though?
scene nikilove11
: What if I don’t think that starting over with you is the right idea? What if I don’t want to be with you the way you want to be with me?
: Then you’re a fucking idiot. I’m a catch. And I can do that thing with my tongue where-
: Niki, wait.
: Fine. But you know the thing I’m talking about.
: I just...can’t make a change as big as this right now.
: Then when? Because I want to say I’m not going to wait around forever, but that would obviously be a lie when I am this...well, addicted to you.
: I’m a horrible thing to be addicted to.
: I sometimes think it would have been safer to just start doing drugs.
: Listen, you-
scene nikilove12
: No. You listen!
: I’m obviously not expecting you to drop the whole life you made for yourself out of thin air because I decided to re-confess...
: But I’m throwing out a bunch of ideas because, no matter what happens, I want to be with you!
: That’s all I’ve ever wanted for as long as I’ve known you!
: And sure, it was just as friends at first. But I will never, in a million lifetimes, ever be able to do that again!
: Not when I know how fucked up and empty my amazing life is without you in it.
: I still am in it, though.
: Yeah, but you're not in the right fucking place!
: Look at us! Look at who we are on the inside now!
: We’re ugly and empty and lonely and hurting and all of those things were a lot less scary when we had each other to fall back on!
: Let me fall on you again! Be there for me and I’ll be there for you! Until we’re old and jaded and I can’t do the tongue thing anymore!
: Okay, you really need to stop yelling.
: Then fucking kiss me and make me stop, damn it! I’ve been waiting for it this entire time!
: Niki-
: Screw it! I’ll do it myself!
scene nikilove13
Niki pulls herself forward in a violent lunge that manages to transform into a light push at the very last instant.
Her lips press against mine, the same way they did on Christmas night many years ago when we decided to change our relationship forever.
I wonder if we’d still be standing here today if that never happened.
I wonder if this kiss would feel even half as good as it does without years of history gushing out of it.
Of course I want Niki.
In fact, it’s probably one of the things I’m most certain about right now.
But I can’t have her the same way I can have the other girls.
She wants the version of me she grew up with. The one who (At least presumably) sat there listening to her problems and helping her through them when necessary.
She wants the person who helped her discover what it means to love. How it feels to be touched.
She wants someone who doesn’t exist anymore.
Why does one measly memory entitle me to that?
scene nikilove14
: Are we really not getting back together? Because, maybe I’ve just been reading too much manga, but this played out a little differently in my head.
: Did you think you were just going to confess out of the blue like that and that we’d ride off into the sunset together?
: Obviously not. It’s night time. The sun has already set.
: You know what I mean.
: Besides, I already knew you felt this way. Maybe not in as much detail, but I still knew.
: I just...don’t really understand why. Do you...not see me that way anymore or something?
: That’s not it.
: Then what is it? Help me understand.
: If I’m going to keep fucking waiting for you, I’d at least like to know what I’m waiting for.
: It’s not really something that I can easily describe.
: I just don’t think we should be together until I feel a little less...numb.
scene nikilove15
: Ugh. That’ll take years. You’ve been saying that for as long as I’ve known you.
: Listen, there’s obviously no rush since I have zero interest in anyone else, but don’t keep me waiting forever...okay?
: I’m really bad at taking no for an answer, but I love you enough to let it happen every once in a while.
: I appreciate you accepting that I, too, have free will. That’s very generous of you, Niki.
: Don’t get snippy with me, asshole. And get a new fucking blazer, would you? This thing is worn to hell.
: This is a good shirt. You take that back.
scene nikilove16
: So, I’m guessing there’s not much hope in getting you to leave your lame school party and come back to a different, fancier hotel with me?
: Maybe next time. I’ve already been gone for a while and kind of told someone that I’d meet up with them next.
: I’m sorry it wasn’t the result you were looking for, but I am glad you came here to tell me all of that.
: Yeah, yeah. Whatever. If you’re not going to give my box back, at least try skimming through some of the nicer letters to see if any more of your memories come back.
: I knew they would eventually. Just didn’t think it would take this fucking long.
: I don’t understand how you can still be so accepting of me after all I’ve put you through.
: The same reason I frantically came over here in the middle of the night to tell you all of this.
: Because I miss you.
scene nikilove17
: It’s a shame you didn’t want to come back to my hotel, though.
: I was thinking tonight could be the night.
: I’m sorry, what was that?
scene nikilove18
: Ooooooh, nothing~
: Just that it must really suck to be you right now.
scene nikilove19
: Feel free to text me if you get bored or something. Maybe I’ll even give you a little peek at what you’re missing out on?
: Actually...maybe not. I don’t know how fun it would be since you’re so numb and all.
: Oh, and get a new blazer! It’s okay to treat yourself on Christmas!
: Also, I love you!
: Goodnight!
scene black
Niki’s voice gets harder to hear with each sentence as she distances herself from the hotel.
I don’t know if I’d count this as a rejection if I was her, but I’m sure it didn’t feel good to pour her heart out like that to such a lackluster response.
I am the king of lackluster responses, though.
Just as I’m the king of luring young women into relationships that only I stand to benefit from.
But, maybe one day, if I can ever become who it is I am supposed to be-
Or who it is I was-
Maybe then, that won’t be the case anymore.
